name: codecortex
description: Helps Claude understand your whole codebase: find the right code, see what a change affects, pick the tests to run, and show what it did.
long_description:
CodeCortex runs locally on your computer and gives Claude a map of your code project.

- **Find the right code fast** instead of reading hundreds of files
- **See the blast radius** of a change before it is made
- **Know which tests to run** for a change
- **See what Claude did** in a local dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:7331

Nothing leaves your machine. After installing, ask Claude: *Show CodeCortex status*.

project_folder.title: Your code project folder
project_folder.description: The folder that holds the code you want Claude to work on (for example the folder you cloned from Git). You can change it later in Claude's extension settings.

tools.name: codecortex_status
tools.description: Shows which project CodeCortex is looking at and where the dashboard is

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Finds the files and functions relevant to a task

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Locates a function, class or variable in the project

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Shows what else in the project a change would affect

tools.name: tests_required
tools.description: Lists the tests that should run for a change
